codes.condition: Fetching an answer Search declined or answered with the catalogue.
Fetching an answer with a part that has no reading, when the fetch is not partial or no part has a reading.
A base URL is empty, is not an absolute http or https URL, or carries userinfo.
A choice whose part or option names no gap, several gaps or no option, or a choice that cannot post back a part.
A response lacks a member the client acts on, or holds one that contradicts the request.
The credentials file breaks the credentials-file rule.
The credentials file exists but cannot be read.
The call's deadline passed before it finished.
A downloaded file does not hash to the digest its manifest names, after the files route was asked once more.
The signed URL a files route names refused, or its fetch failed, after the route was asked once more.
A header value holds a control character.
A key would travel over plain http to a host that is not loopback.
A call's arguments break a rule the client checks before any request.
The api_key argument is an empty string.
The api_key holds a character outside visible ASCII.
The connection failed before a response arrived.
DFO_OFFLINE=1 is set, and the call needs the server.
DFO_PROFILE names a profile the credentials file lacks.
The chosen profile in the credentials file has no key.
A refusal whose body carries no code: no problem document, or one without a code.
A decoded response body passes its size cap.
A response of a status or form the call does not act on: a redirect it does not follow, a body that is not JSON, or a status the route does not answer.
A stored version can no longer be fetched, and no refusal names why.
